zh: 合法片段里不能有数字，所以任何合法子串都不可能跨过一个数字；数字把整个字符串切成了若干段纯字母片段。
在同一个纯字母段里，只要整段含有至少一个大写字母，整段本身就是该段内最长的合法子串；不含大写字母的段则不贡献答案。
在字符串末尾补一个哨兵数字，从左到右扫描并记录当前段的起点；每遇到数字就检查从起点到它之前的这一段是否有大写字母，有则用段长更新答案，然后把起点移到数字之后；答案初值为 -1，最后输出。
en: A valid segment cannot contain digits, so no valid substring can cross a digit; the digits cut the string into letter-only pieces.
Inside one letter-only piece, as long as the piece contains at least one uppercase letter, the whole piece is the longest valid substring in it; a piece without uppercase letters contributes nothing.

Append a sentinel digit to the string, scan from left to right and remember where the current piece starts; at every digit, check whether the piece from that start up to just before the digit has an uppercase letter, and if so update the answer with its length, then move the start past the digit; the answer starts at -1 and is printed at the end.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Digits split the string into letter-only segments; only segments that contain an uppercase letter are valid.

## Proof of correctness

No valid substring can cross a digit, so it lies entirely within one letter segment separated by digits; it suffices to check whether each segment contains an uppercase letter.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(1).
